_how_to: Copy this whole folder into characters/, rename the folder, change name below, restart the pets. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.
name: Pip
_scale: screen pixels per normal-size art pixel at 100% display scaling
_head: [x, y standing, y sitting] in normal-size art pixels: where speech bubbles and hearts start
_item: where the food is drawn while eating, in normal-size art pixels
_extra_states: extra weight for built-in moves (walk is 40, idle 20, loaf 20); your own moves go in behaviours.py
_climb_style: claws (clings to the screen edge, uses climb1/climb2 sprites) or hover (floats up on a glow)
_watch_pose: loaf (the default), stand, or any sprite of its own (e.g. sit): how it watches while you are in a fullscreen app
_relationships: how it feels about other pets by name, e.g. {"Mochi": "bestie", "Echo": "dislikes"}. Kinds: loves, bestie, friend, dislikes. Anyone not listed is a friend.

lines._lines: Each moment has a list of things to say; one is picked at random. {other} = the other pet's name, {time} = the clock, {mins} = minutes since start.
break: You've been working a while. Take a break!
lines._moods: what 'How are you?' says when tired, hungry, or otherwise
lines._hello_loves: add _loves, _bestie or _dislikes to any line key for a version used with those pets
lines._bounce: used by the example move in behaviours.py - lines can have any name you like
